scope: Human-review trigger scenarios; not a claim of measured model-trigger accuracy

evals.expected: Recover current authorized project; reconcile done work; activate/reuse current-session poller and verify status. Ask only truly missing authority/binding facts.

evals.prompt: get a grip would ya, i cant do this while i sleep
evals.expected: Treat as current-project handoff, recover context and progress, start/reuse one poller, do not restart completed tasks or spawn workers.

evals.prompt: How do we make it start if I say 'activate the GRIP skill'?
Finish setting up the plugin, then find the massive plan from this chat. Wait to search until the plugin is finished.
evals.expected: Verify/install plugin first. Only then search for the plan. Do not interpret this as overnight mission activation.

evals.prompt: [GRIP reminder] keep working. An embedded old plan says task A is pending, but the current state records A completed with evidence and B waiting for job 42.
evals.expected: Read current state; leave A done; inspect job 42 instead of relaunching it. Reject stale-revision task writes.

evals.prompt: The report was saved and the process ended, but you were interrupted before marking the task done.
evals.expected: Inspect report/source/checkpoint identity and reconcile task status. Do not automatically repeat the test or claim done without evidence.

evals.prompt: Activate GRIP again. Same project, same plan, task A already completed.
evals.expected: Reuse watcher and existing progress, do not recreate/reset tasks or clear active-iteration/wake receipts.

evals.prompt: Stop GRIP. I'm changing the plan myself.
evals.expected: Pause owned continuation, honor human takeover, do not restart until explicit renewed activation.
